title: Yoisaki Kanade — This Spring, With You...〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All that's left is to see what everybody thinks, make adjustments based on that and our next song should be ready...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll have to start thinking about the next song too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That song I heard on the way back from the hospital was so nice...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The guitarist did a good job too. Some parts sounded a little unrefined, but it felt both powerful and kind at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I doubt I could create the same sound even if I had the music in front of me...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Only the person who was playing that can probably create the atmosphere I felt...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Powerful but kind, and a hint of doubt...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This should turn into a good melody.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I've just been working on my own part, but what's the plan for today?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That should be fine for now. But can I ask you to give something a listen before you do?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh! Did you think of something for the song after the next one?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I did. It's far from done, but I'd like to hear what you all think.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sure, why not? Just give me a second.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You made this the same way you always do, K...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Huh? Yes, I did but... Was something off about it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, nothing like that. The melody feels like something you'd come up with but...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Having such a bright and happy opening seems rare coming from you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <At the same time, there seemed to be some deeper meaning behind this melody...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, that! I can't put my finger on it, but didn't it feel like it was trying to encourage you or something?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Actually, it's based off something I heard a street performer play the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The sound felt like something only they could produce and I kind of liked it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I wanted to capture that feeling somehow and create a melody that reflected my impression of that performance.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But if it deviates too far from what we usually make as N25, I'll scrap it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, I think it'll be fine. It might actually even end up being a nice little surprise.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'd like to hear it once all the way through.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay, I understand.
Let's make this one together...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright! Now you gotta give us the full version of this song!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Yoisaki.
Shall I start cooking and cleaning as always?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Mochizuki. I need to thank you for the cherry blossoms from the other day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They've all wilted and the branch has sort of dried out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I was able to show it to the person I was hoping to most.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
I'm glad I could help.
